 - VIDEO NOTES

Dallas Jenkins is the creator and director of "The Chosen". In this video, he shows me around the show's Midlothian set.

 - LINKS

Watch the trailer for season six of The Chosen: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nymMxV88QyY&feature=youtu.be

Season six premieres November 15th on Prime Video, with three episodes at launch and new episodes weekly through December 6. And the story doesn't end on streaming — the season finale arrives as a feature film, exclusively in theaters, on March 12, 2027.
